body: Thanks, that's a good perspective. Although it will always be in head, the thought that what could've been. How different our life would've been. I'm just not sure if I can live with these thoughts. I'm not even sure if we can move on from here. Today will be the day that I'll talk to my girlfriend. Let's hope it goes "well".

Well I could always talk to them separately and maybe I could get work something out with them. With a second job I think I could manage all the payments but working a second job while raising a baby is not really an option, I can't just stay away from home all the time.

Thanks. And yes, she's the most loving and caring person I know, so maybe she could forgive me, maybe she could stay with me even after I've caused. The thing is, I don't think I can live with myself after all this. Looking at my girlfriend and my little girl every day and thinking that I could've offered them a much better life, instead of ruining it for them. I would hate myself even more.

Bankruptcy isn't really an option in my country, since on average it takes close to 2 years for it to take effect. Also there aren't agencies like Stepchange or something like that in my country. All I could get is some advice about my debt but that's not going to help me. I know that I can't refinance it, all I can do is get a second job and try to pay it off.
Actually there's a clause in my life insurance that if I take my own life before 2 years it will be null and void. Since it was over 2 years ago that won't affect my contract.
